rows.evidence: The only thing at this place is the paper's faint, large, light-grey watermark lettering behind the handwriting, roughly "RONDE … A T T X … S T R …". It is not Grothendieck's ink, so nothing is written there to transcribe, and leaving it out, as both witnesses did, is right.
